name: ipatool
description_en: Command-line tool that allows searching and downloading app packages (known as ipa files) for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and visionOS from the App Store.
readme_excerpt: IPATool ipatool is a command line tool that allows you to search for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and visionOS apps on the App Store and download a copy of the app package, known as an ipa file. - Requirements - Installation - Manual - Package Manager (macOS) - Usage - Compiling - License - Releases - FAQ Requirements - Supported operating system (Windows, Linux or macOS). - Apple ID set up to use the App Store.
